name: Cyber
rootCause: According to Cyber's official Twitter, the Discord server @BuildOnCyber of the decentralized social L2 Cyber (formerly CyberConnect) was compromised. A phishing link was posted in the announcements channel and all permissions have been stripped. Do not interact with the attached announcement, Do not click any links.
